description: Makes a NEW report that belongs to the person from chosen parts of a report they may read: a slide deck (an opening slide, then one slide per board: its name the heading, its words and pictures on the slide, its sticky notes the speaker notes) or a document (one section per board). Pick the maker and the parts from list_report_makers; leave `parts` out to use every part. The parts are used in the order a reader meets them, whatever order you give. Pictures are reused, not uploaded again; a board that is a live page runs as that page. The original is left as it was, and its live data, comments, shares and links are not carried. It keeps who may read it: parts of a version only owners and admins may read make a report only they may read. It lands in the same project unless you give `project_id`, and is called after the original ("Spring menu deck") unless you give `title`. The answer gives the new report's id, its version number and the parts used, not its content.

maker.description: The maker's id from list_report_makers, such as `deck` or `document`.

parts.description: The parts to make from, each once. Leave it out for every part.

within.description: The part's `ref.within` from list_report_makers, when it has one.

project_id.description: The project the new report belongs to (list_projects gives ids). Leave it out for the original's project.

report_id.description: The report to make from (list_reports gives ids).

title.description: The new report's title. Leave it out for the original's with the maker's word.

version.description: The version to read the parts from. Leave it out for the newest.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: make_report
title: Make a deck or document from a report
